meta.name: campaign-architect
meta.description: Use when the user asks to "plan my paid account structure", "pick Search vs PMax", "lay out ad groups / asset groups", or "audit paid-vs-organic cannibalization"; designs campaign-type selection, ad-group/asset-group layout, targeting + match types, negative/exclusion hygiene, and a paid↔organic overlap audit, and scores the ROAS A (Audience) dimension + structure. Not for computing the final RQS — use ad-account-auditor; not for budget split — use budget-optimizer; not for organic site architecture — use site-structure-optimizer. 付费广告账户结构/广告系列规划/否定关键词

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 规划付费广告账户结构，优化广告系列与关键词布局
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在管理付费搜索广告账户，需要系统规划广告系列和关键词策略。
copy.tagline_en: Plan paid ad account structure, optimize campaign and keyword layout
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage paid search ad accounts and need systematic campaign and keyword strategy.

howto.what: 帮你规划付费广告账户的结构，包括选择广告系列类型（搜索/PMax/广泛匹配）、设计广告组或资产组布局、设置定向和匹配类型、建立否定关键词和排除列表，并检查付费与自然搜索是否重叠。
howto.when: 当你需要设计或重构付费广告账户结构时，例如询问“规划我的付费账户结构”、“选择搜索还是PMax”、“布局广告组”或“审计付费与自然搜索重叠”。

say.text: 规划我的付费广告账户结构，目标是提升转化率。
say.note: 触发技能开始规划账户结构。

say.text: 帮我选择搜索广告还是PMax，并布局广告组。
say.note: 技能会分析并推荐广告系列类型和分组。

say.text: 审计付费与自然搜索的流量重叠。
say.note: 技能会对比付费查询和自然落地页，标记重叠。

howto.what_en: Helps plan the structure of a paid ads account: choose campaign types (Search/PMax/broad), design ad group or asset group layout, set targeting and match types, build negative keyword and exclusion lists, and audit paid vs organic overlap.
howto.when_en: When you need to design or restructure a paid ads account before launch, e.g., ask to "plan my paid account structure", "pick Search vs PMax", "lay out ad groups", or "audit paid-vs-organic cannibalization".

say_en.text: Plan my paid account structure for conversion optimization.
say_en.note: Triggers the skill to start planning.

say_en.text: Should I use Search or PMax? Lay out ad groups.
say_en.note: Skill analyzes and recommends campaign type and grouping.

say_en.text: Audit paid vs organic traffic overlap.
say_en.note: Skill compares paid queries and organic landing pages.
